name: Pure Girl
source:
Satoru and his younger sister Sora had to find a new place to live when their parents decided to go on a long trip and also renovate the house at the same time. They ended up at the "Dream House". With an open-concept design, a spacious interior, a large pool with jacuzzi, as well as an outdoor bath with a mountain view, it's everything you could have wanted from a home. The landlord Kei welcomed them and the three other residents Yogiri, Miyako and Suzu: "Perversion is something you should hide, but not something you should be ashamed of!". Satoru immediately refuted that they were perverts, but he did not yet know at that time that the girls all had hidden fetishes.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/09/01/september-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
悟和妹妹空因为父母决定出远门旅行并同时翻新房子，不得不寻找新的住处。他们最终来到了“梦之屋”。开放式设计、宽敞的室内空间、带按摩浴缸的大泳池，还有可以眺望山景的露天浴池——这里拥有一切你对理想住所的期待。房东惠迎接了他们以及另外三位住客——夜雾、都和铃：“变态是要藏起来的，但不是要感到羞耻的！”悟立刻反驳说他们不是变态，但他当时还不知道，这些女孩们其实都有着隐藏的性癖。
